name: cxj
description: Cold-open Java/Spring code intelligence with five checkable properties: the only latency is one cold read (30-250 ms on production services; 2.4 s on 1.5M-line Spring Framework); trusts only your source (tree-sitter, certainty labels, no embeddings); read-safe and write-safe (query commands write nothing and touch no network — nothing to go stale, nothing to leak); honest about repo scale (persistent graphs are for 28M-LOC outliers); and Spring is the domain model (routes, beans, qualifiers, profiles, config keys, resolved dependency versions). Requires the cxj binary: brew install umuterturk/tap/cxj, npm i -g @umutert/cxj, or a release asset.
